intended_object: A helper diagram: for a filtered diagram i ↦ F_i of abelian sheaves on X, it sends i to the cochain complex of global sections Γ(X, C•(F_i)) of the functorial flasque resolution of F_i. It is used to prove that sheaf cohomology commutes with filtered colimits on compact, quasi-separated, prespectral spaces.
explanation: The definition is an `abbrev` that composes three functors: the input diagram F, the library's functorial flasque resolution `flasqueResolutionNat`, and the global-sections functor applied degreewise to cochain complexes. It is used only inside the proof in `FilteredColimitFunctorH.lean`, which takes colimits of this diagram and compares their homology with the cohomology of colimit F. This is a proof device, not a standard object from the literature. The construction itself is coherent. It also only makes sense with the library's chosen functorial flasque resolution, so there is no general Mathlib notion it would be a narrow case of. The extra assumptions in scope (X compact, prespectral, quasi-separated, the `HasExt` instance) come from section variables and are not needed by the body.
